jobs.label: New task
jobs.meaning: add a task, a to-do or a reminder for themselves

fields.title: the task itself, in the member's own words, without 'remind me to'

jobs.note: The owning pane is Projects since the OP-4 flip (2026-10-25): My Tasks left the nav, and its inbox is the My work section of Projects. WS-64: a member who lacks feature:projects but holds feature:tasks gets the job at /tasks?do=capture (the fallback).

jobs.label: New space
jobs.meaning: start a new space, project or department board in Projects
jobs.note: A root node in Projects is a SPACE (the tree grammar of migration 193), so the label names what opens: the New space row in the tree.
